entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I'm calling because I need to return something, and I just feel so let down. I'm hoping you can help.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into this for you. Could I get your name and order number to start?
Yes, my name is Sarah Miller, and the order is VF-8675309. It's for that new helmet. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I was so excited, but... it's just not right.

Thank you, Sarah. I see your account here and I appreciate you being a VIP member with us. I've found the order for the Aero-X helmet. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the helmet?

It's the color. It looked so much brighter on the website. I know it's a small thing, but I can't bring myself to wear it. The box is still unopened, I haven't even taken it out. I just feel terrible because I really needed that money back for some other expenses.
Not a small thing at all, Sarah. We want you to love the gear you ride with. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Okay, thank you. I was just so worried it had been too long.
Alright, I've confirmed it. You are well within our 90-day return window. Since you received the helmet 43 days ago, we can absolutely process a full refund for you. No problem at all.
Oh, really? That's such a relief. I was honestly expecting a 'no'.

Of course. Your satisfaction and safety are our top priorities, and having the right gear is part of that. I have just initiated that return. You'll receive a prepaid shipping label in your email within the next five minutes. Since the box is unopened, just attach the label and drop it at any post office.
That's wonderful. Thank you so much, David.
You are very welcome. And Sarah, as a thank you for your loyalty and to apologize for the disappointment with the color, I've also added a $15 credit to your account for your next purchase with us.
Wow, you really didn't have to do that! That's so kind. You've completely turned my day around.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again for being so helpful.
You're welcome, Sarah. Have a wonderful day, and happy riding.
